schemaRecommendation.backwardsCompatibility: Keep existing English/canonical fields for grading and current UI.
schemaRecommendation.lesson: Add localization.fr.title, localization.fr.grammarFocus, localization.fr.readingOutcome and localization.fr.objectives.
schemaRecommendation.exercise: Add localization.fr.prompt, hint, explanation, options where applicable, plus localized accepted-answer overrides only when the answer itself is language-dependent.
schemaRecommendation.gradingRule: Never translate the canonical grading value blindly. Multiple-choice localization maps French labels by option index/value; free-text exercises receive explicit French accepted variants when required.
schemaRecommendation.implementedStage1: Lessons 1-5 now use localization.fr for lesson metadata, block titles, exercise text, aligned option labels and matching labels while canonical grading fields remain untouched.
schemaRecommendation.implementedStage2: Lessons 6-10 now use the same localization.fr contract as Stage 1; canonical expectedAnswer and acceptedVariants remain untouched.
schemaRecommendation.implementedStage3: Lessons 11-15 now use the same localization.fr contract; all canonical grading, source and provenance fields remain unchanged.

validationPolicy: Existing 245 learnerCopy blocks must remain bilingual.
Existing 835 vocabulary/support glosses must remain bilingual.
Future parity completion should become a hard CI gate stage by stage, not a one-shot flag.
Lessons 1-5 are a hard French-parity CI gate: localized lesson metadata, block titles, exercise prompt/hint/explanation, option-label cardinality and matching-label key parity are required.
French localization objects must not define expectedAnswer or acceptedVariants; grading remains canonical.
Lessons 6-10 are a hard French-parity CI gate under the same 1:1 display-label mapping and canonical-grading preservation rules.
Lessons 11-15 are a hard French-parity CI gate under the same aligned-display and canonical-grading preservation rules.
